name: Togawa Raina no Toilet de Kami-sama, Boshuu Chuu
original_name: 十川良衣菜のトイレで神様、募集中
source:
After making a mistake, homeless schoolgirl Raina Togawa has until tomorrow to raise a whole lot of money! 100,000 yen, to be exact! If she gives one blowjob for 5,000 yen, that's... 20 blowjobs.

Will she be able to raise the money in time with some help from her similarly slutty friends Kotoha and Chiko? Play this fundraising adventure and find out!

[From the [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ145617.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English page[/url]]
